description: Request an export of a specified Zendesk view and return the response as a downloadable file, along with the view ID and content type.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for exporting a Zendesk view as CSV.

view_id.description: The numeric ID of the view to export. You can find view IDs in the Zendesk admin panel under Views or by listing views via the API.
view_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the view you want to export. You can find this ID in the Zendesk Views section of your admin panel.
view_id.title: View Id

inputSchema.title: GetViewsExportRequest

name: get_views_export

s3url.description: S3 URL of the downloaded file.
s3url.title: S3Url

GetViewsExportResponse.description: Response containing the exported view data as a CSV file.

content_type.description: The content type of the response (e.g., 'text/csv')
content_type.title: Content Type

csv_content.description: The CSV file content containing the exported view data. Use the .content attribute to access the raw bytes, or .path to get the temporary file path.
csv_content.title: Csv Content

view_id.description: The ID of the view that was exported
view_id.title: View Id

GetViewsExportResponse.title: GetViewsExportResponse
